name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric Scheme

provider.name: Social Welfare & Backward Classes Welfare Dept, Govt of Karnataka

shortSummary: State post-matric assistance covering tuition fees and monthly maintenance for eligible resident college students.
detailedDescription: The State Scholarship Portal (SSP) of Karnataka acts as a unified platform for post-matric fee reimbursement and maintenance allowances provided by the Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, Minorities, and Backward Classes Welfare departments.

benefit.headline: Full/Partial Tuition Fee Reimbursement + Monthly Maintenance
benefit.details: Covers statutory government tuition fees and living stipend disbursed directly via Aadhaar-seeded NPCI bank transfer.

deadlineNotes: Cycle dates are verified against official GoK circular; portal closes at 23:59 IST on closing day.

rules.label: Domicile State
rules.explanation: Applicant must hold Karnataka domicile confirmed by state revenue certificate.

rules.label: Current Study Level
rules.explanation: Must be enrolled in an accredited post-matric college program in Karnataka.

rules.label: Household Annual Income Ceiling
rules.explanation: Annual family gross income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 for standard welfare category claims.

documents.title: Caste & Income Certificate (15-digit RD Number)
documents.description: Issued by Karnataka Revenue Department (Nemmadi Kendra / Atalji Janasnehi Kendra). SSP fetches details using the RD reference code.

documents.title: Aadhaar Seeding with NPCI Bank Account
documents.description: Bank account must be active and linked with NPCI mapper for Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

documents.title: College Admission Fee Receipt & Student USN/Registration Number
documents.description: Official receipt from college stating fee breakdown, along with institutional registration number.

documents.title: Hostel Admission Certificate (If residing in hostel)
documents.description: Certificate from Warden/Principal confirming government or recognized private hostel residence.

steps.title: Generate Student SSP ID
steps.description: Register on ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in using your Aadhaar number and registered mobile phone.

steps.title: Enter RD Caste/Income Reference Number
steps.description: Enter the 15-digit RD number; the portal pulls digitized revenue records directly.

steps.title: Select College & Course via Kutumba/AISHE Code
steps.description: Verify your admission details pushed by your college onto the Karnataka State Higher Education portal.

steps.title: Submit Application & Submit Signed Acknowledgement to College
steps.description: Download final PDF acknowledgement, sign it, and hand over a copy to your college scholarship officer for e-attestation.

sources.organization: Centre for e-Governance, Government of Karnataka
sources.excerpt: Post-Matric Scholarship portal for Karnataka students across Social Welfare, Tribal Welfare, BCW, and Minorities departments.

sources.organization: Social Welfare Department, Government of Karnataka
sources.excerpt: Income criteria and RD integration specifications for student scholarship claims.
sources.notes: Income ceiling verified from official SW department notification.

name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students (CSSS)

provider.name: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education, Govt of India

shortSummary: National merit-cum-means scholarship for all Indian students scoring above 80th percentile in Class 12 board examinations pursuing regular degree courses.
detailedDescription: The Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students is implemented across all states and union territories in India by the Department of Higher Education to provide financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families.

benefit.headline: ₹12,000 / year for Undergraduate (₹20,000 / year at PG level)
benefit.details: Annual grant disbursed in installments or lump-sum via Direct Benefit Transfer through PFMS.

deadlineNotes: NSP portal applications typically close on November 30; institutional verification deadline extends 15 days later.

rules.label: Enrolled Study Level
rules.explanation: Must be enrolled in the 1st year of a regular (non-correspondence / non-distance) degree course in India.

rules.label: Class 12 Board Percentage / Percentile
rules.explanation: Must have scored above the 80th percentile cutoff in Class 12 (or minimum 80% mark benchmark).

rules.label: Annual Family Income Ceiling
rules.explanation: Gross family annual income from all sources must not exceed ₹4,50,000.

documents.title: Class 12 Board Marksheet
documents.description: Original marksheet issued by CBSE, ICSE, or State Higher Secondary Education Board.

documents.title: Competent Authority Family Income Certificate
documents.description: Income certificate issued by Tahsildar, Revenue Officer, or competent revenue authority (recent 6 months).

documents.title: College Bonafide Student Certificate
documents.description: Official Bonafide signed and stamped by the Head of the Institution / College Principal with AISHE Code.

documents.title: Bank Passbook with Account Number & IFSC
documents.description: Savings bank account in student's sole name, seeded with Aadhaar in NPCI mapping.

steps.title: One-Time Registration (OTR) on NSP
steps.description: Complete face-auth or biometric verification on the National Scholarship Portal to generate your OTR ID.

steps.title: Fill Scheme Application & Select College
steps.description: Choose Higher Education Department -> Central Sector Scheme. Select your college via AISHE search.

steps.title: Upload Document Verification Copies
steps.description: Upload scanned copies of Class 12 marksheet, income certificate, and Bonafide.

steps.title: Nodal Officer Institutional Verification
steps.description: Inform your college scholarship nodal officer to verify and approve the application before the institute cutoff.

sources.organization: Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology, Govt of India
sources.excerpt: National Scholarship Portal CSSS scheme guidelines, application workflow, and timeline.
sources.notes: Verified against 2026 Guidelines document from education.gov.in.

sources.organization: Department of Higher Education, Govt of India
sources.excerpt: Central Sector Scheme eligibility, income ceiling ₹4.5 Lakhs, 80th percentile board criteria.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students

provider.name: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)

shortSummary: Empowering young women pursuing professional degree or diploma courses in AICTE-approved engineering institutions across all states in India.
detailedDescription: Pragati is an initiative implemented by AICTE through the National Scholarship Portal to encourage girl students across all Indian states and Union Territories to pursue technical education. Up to two girl children per family are eligible.

benefit.headline: ₹50,000 per annum for tuition fees, computer, and academic supplies
benefit.details: Lump sum ₹50,000 credited annually into the student's Aadhaar-linked savings account.

deadlineNotes: Cycle verified on National Scholarship Portal guidelines; institute verification follows.

rules.label: Gender
rules.explanation: Scheme is exclusively for girl students.

rules.label: Study Level
rules.explanation: Must be admitted in 1st year of technical degree or diploma course in an AICTE-approved institution.

rules.label: Annual Family Income Ceiling
rules.explanation: Total family annual income must not exceed ₹8,00,000 from all sources.

documents.title: Class 10 and 12 / ITI / Diploma Marksheets
documents.description: Authentic copies of qualifying examination certificates.

documents.title: Centralized Admission Allotment Letter
documents.description: Allotment letter issued by state CET/JEE admission authority confirming entry into AICTE-approved course.

documents.title: Family Income Certificate (Tahsildar/SDM)
documents.description: Income certificate stating family income does not exceed 8 Lakhs per annum.

documents.title: Two-Girl-Child Family Declaration (Form A)
documents.description: Parent declaration signed by parents confirming not more than two girls are claiming the scheme.

steps.title: Register on National Scholarship Portal
steps.description: Complete student OTR registration on scholarships.gov.in.

steps.title: Select AICTE Pragati Degree / Diploma Scheme
steps.description: Fill personal and academic credentials; link AICTE permanent institute ID.

steps.title: Upload Mandated Certificates & Declaration
steps.description: Upload attested copies of admission letter, income certificate, and Parent declaration.

steps.title: Institutional Verification on NSP Portal
steps.description: College Institute Nodal Officer verifies admission legitimacy before forwarding to AICTE.

sources.organization: All India Council for Technical Education
sources.excerpt: Pragati scholarship criteria: girl students admitted to technical degree courses with family income under ₹8 lakh.

name: Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna (EBC)

provider.name: Directorate of Higher Education, Govt of Maharashtra

shortSummary: Maharashtra 50% tuition and examination fee reimbursement for economically backward general category students.
detailedDescription: Administered via the MahaDBT portal by the Directorate of Higher Education (DHE) and Directorate of Technical Education (DTE) Maharashtra for students admitted through the Centralized Admission Process (CAP).

benefit.headline: 50% Tuition & Exam Fee Reimbursement
benefit.details: Direct reimbursement of 50% tuition fees paid to private or aided college, directly into student bank account.

deadlineNotes: MahaDBT post-matric renewal and fresh application deadline for current academic year.

rules.label: Domicile State
rules.explanation: Applicant must be a permanent resident of Maharashtra with a valid domicile certificate.

rules.label: Study Level
rules.explanation: Must be admitted to higher education or technical degree course via CAP process.

rules.label: Family Income Limit
rules.explanation: Annual family gross income must not exceed ₹8,00,000.

documents.title: Maharashtra Domicile Certificate
documents.description: Issued by Tahsildar / Sub-Divisional Officer in Maharashtra.

documents.title: Income Certificate from Competent Authority
documents.description: Annual income certificate issued by Tahsildar for the financial year.

documents.title: CAP Allotment Letter
documents.description: Official confirmation slip of admission secured through centralized admission process.

documents.title: Ration Card / Family Declaration
documents.description: Ration card verifying family member count and dependency.

steps.title: Register on MahaDBT Portal
steps.description: Create applicant profile on mahadbt.maharashtra.gov.in using Aadhaar authentication.

steps.title: Complete 6-Stage Student Profile
steps.description: Fill personal, address, other details, current course, past qualification, and hostel info.

steps.title: Select DHE / DTE EBC Scheme
steps.description: Apply under Rajarshi Chhatrapati Shahu Maharaj Shikshan Shulkh Shishyavrutti Yojna.

steps.title: Submit for Scrutiny by College Clerk
steps.description: College desk scrutinizes uploaded certificates before forwarding to DHE joint director.

name: Uttar Pradesh Post-Matric Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement Scheme

provider.name: Social Welfare & Backward Class Welfare Dept, Govt of Uttar Pradesh

shortSummary: Fee reimbursement and maintenance stipend for permanent Uttar Pradesh residents enrolled in higher education courses.
detailedDescription: The Uttar Pradesh Scholarship and Fee Reimbursement Online System provides state financial aid for students studying in recognized universities, polytechnics, and colleges across UP.

benefit.headline: Full College Tuition Fee Reimbursement + Annual Living Allowance
benefit.details: Non-refundable fees reimbursed directly to the student's Aadhaar-seeded bank account via PFMS.

deadlineNotes: Cycle verified on scholarship.up.gov.in; college forward cutoff follows in January.

rules.label: Domicile State
rules.explanation: Must be a bona fide resident of Uttar Pradesh with a valid state domicile certificate.

rules.label: Study Level
rules.explanation: Must be pursuing an approved post-matric course in an affiliated institution.

rules.label: Family Income Ceiling
rules.explanation: Gross family annual income must not exceed ₹2,50,000 (₹2,00,000 for General/OBC).

documents.title: UP Niwas (Domicile) Certificate
documents.description: Digital domicile certificate issued through edistrict.up.gov.in portal.

documents.title: Family Income Certificate (Aay Praman Patra)
documents.description: Tahsildar authorized income certificate with computerized application number.

documents.title: Previous Qualifying Marksheet & Fee Receipt
documents.description: Original fee deposit slip signed by the college registrar.

steps.title: Online Registration on UP Scholarship Portal
steps.description: Register under Post-Matric other than inter category on scholarship.up.gov.in.

steps.title: Aadhaar Demography & OTP Authentication
steps.description: Verify your identity using Aadhaar e-KYC on the portal.

steps.title: Submit Final Print to College Desk
steps.description: Submit the computerized application printout along with fee receipts to your college within 3 days.

sources.organization: Social Welfare Department, Government of Uttar Pradesh
sources.excerpt: Guidelines for UP Post-Matric Fee Reimbursement scheme and e-District verification.

name: Tamil Nadu Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme

provider.name: Adi Dravidar and Tribal Welfare Dept, Govt of Tamil Nadu

shortSummary: Full tuition waiver and mandatory fee coverage for students in government, aided, and self-financing engineering colleges in Tamil Nadu.
detailedDescription: Implemented by the Government of Tamil Nadu to provide complete educational cost mitigation for eligible native students pursuing undergraduate degrees.

benefit.headline: 100% Tuition Fee Exemption + Non-refundable Examination Fees
benefit.details: Special fee and tuition fee credited directly to the educational institution or student savings account.

deadlineNotes: Cycle verified with TN Social Welfare gazette notification.

rules.label: Domicile State
rules.explanation: Applicant must be a native of Tamil Nadu with nativity certification.

rules.label: Study Level
rules.explanation: Must be enrolled in higher secondary, degree, or professional college course in Tamil Nadu.

rules.label: Annual Family Income Ceiling
rules.explanation: Total annual family income must not exceed ₹2,50,000.

documents.title: Tamil Nadu Nativity & Community Certificate
documents.description: Issued by Zonal Deputy Tahsildar through e-Sevai centre.

documents.title: Revenue Income Certificate
documents.description: Annual income certificate issued within the past 6 months.

documents.title: College Allotment Order & Fee Receipt
documents.description: Allotment certificate through TNEA or single window counseling.

steps.title: Apply via College Scholarship Desk
steps.description: Submit initial electronic scholarship entry via institutional e-Sevai portal.

steps.title: District Welfare Officer Scrutiny
steps.description: District officer verifies e-district community certificate credentials.

sources.excerpt: Post-Matric Scholarship Scheme for higher studies in Tamil Nadu institutions.
sources.notes: Verified against Tamil Nadu Higher Education concessions.

name: Telangana ePASS Post-Matric Reimbursement of Tuition Fee (RTF)
shortSummary: Full tuition fee reimbursement and maintenance charges for college students in Telangana.
detailedDescription: Administered by the Centre for Good Governance (CGG) for Telangana state students studying in professional and non-professional degree colleges.

benefit.headline: 100% Tuition Fee (RTF) + Monthly Maintenance Allowance (MTF)
benefit.details: Direct college fee reimbursement plus quarterly mess charges credited via DBT.

deadlineNotes: Cycle active on telanganaepass.cgg.gov.in; biometric authentication required.

rules.label: Domicile State
rules.explanation: Must be a native of Telangana with valid MeeSeva certification.

rules.label: Study Level
rules.explanation: Must be enrolled in an affiliated degree or technical college in Telangana.

rules.label: Annual Family Income Ceiling
rules.explanation: Family income must not exceed ₹2,00,000 per annum (₹1,50,000 for rural areas).

documents.title: MeeSeva Integrated Caste & Income Certificate
documents.description: Digitally signed MeeSeva certificate with barcode.

documents.title: SSC (Class 10) Marks Memo & Bonafide
documents.description: School passing certificate and current study bonafide.

steps.title: Register Fresh Application on Telangana ePASS
steps.description: Enter SSC hall ticket number, year of passing, and Aadhaar card number.

steps.title: Biometric Authentication at College
steps.description: Complete biometric authentication on ePASS pos machine at college counter.

sources.organization: Centre for Good Governance, Government of Telangana
sources.excerpt: Telangana ePASS electronic post-matric reimbursement scheme.
sources.notes: Verified against Telangana Welfare Department notification.

name: Delhi Merit-cum-Means Financial Assistance Scheme

provider.name: Directorate of Higher Education, Govt of NCT of Delhi

shortSummary: Up to 100% college tuition fee waiver for students pursuing undergraduate courses in Delhi state universities.
detailedDescription: Provides full or partial fee reimbursement for meritorious and needy students studying in state universities of Delhi (GGSIPU, DTU, NSUT, AUD, IIIT-Delhi, DSEU).

benefit.headline: 100% or 50% Full Tuition Fee Reimbursement
benefit.details: 100% waiver for family income under ₹2.5L; 50% waiver for income between ₹2.5L and ₹6L.

deadlineNotes: Cycle active on Delhi e-District portal.

rules.label: Domicile State
rules.explanation: Applicant must reside in NCT of Delhi with a valid Delhi address or schooling.

rules.label: Study Level
rules.explanation: Must be pursuing an undergraduate degree course in a recognized Delhi state university.

rules.label: Annual Family Income Ceiling
rules.explanation: Income ceiling up to ₹6,00,000 per annum for partial waiver (under ₹2.5 Lakh for 100%).

documents.title: Delhi Revenue SDM Income Certificate
documents.description: Issued by SDM / Revenue Department GNCTD.

documents.title: University Fee Receipt for Current Academic Year
documents.description: Original fee invoice and payment acknowledgement.

steps.title: Register on e-District Delhi Portal
steps.description: Apply under Department of Higher Education -> Merit-cum-Means Financial Assistance.

steps.title: University Level Verification
steps.description: University scholarship committee verifies academic marks and forwards to DHE.
